note: Curated by hand from web research, grouped by market (Middle East, Asia, Africa, Europe, Canada, USA, Latin America, Oceania). Each entry cites its source; update status and asOf when news moves. Status is one of: Plan, Tender, Award, Construction, Commissioning, Operating.

projects.name: Oman–GCC direct interconnection (Ibri–Al Sila 400 kV)
projects.scope: ~530 km double-circuit 400 kV line from Ibri (Oman) to Al Sila (UAE), new substations at Ibri and Baynunah. About 35% complete; service expected by end-2027.
projects.relevance: Large 400 kV overhead line: conductor and earth-wire volumes; follow-on GCC grid expansion.

projects.name: Saudi–Egypt HVDC interconnection
projects.owner: Saudi Energy / Egyptian Electricity Transmission Co.
projects.scope: 500 kV HVDC link, 3,000 MW, ~1,350 km of overhead lines and ~22 km of submarine cable across the Gulf of Aqaba; converter stations at Badr, Tabuk and east of Medina. Launch expected within weeks (Oct 2026).
projects.relevance: Signals further Arab interconnections (common Arab electricity market) that need long overhead lines.

projects.name: Saudi Energy 380 kV BSP and OHTL tender programme
projects.scope: About 20 tenders for 380 kV bulk supply points (BSPs) and overhead transmission lines floated in 2026, about 10 closed. Reported lowest bidders include L&T, SSEM, Alfanar, Linxon and Haif.
projects.relevance: Core market: 380 kV OHTL packages are the main buyers of AAAC/ACSR conductors in the Kingdom. Target the winning EPCs.

projects.name: L&T 380 kV transmission and substation EPC orders
projects.owner: Saudi Energy (and clients in UAE, India)
projects.value: Part of L&T's multi-country PT&D orders
projects.scope: EPC orders in the 380 kV transmission and substation segments in Saudi Arabia, plus orders in the UAE and India.
projects.relevance: L&T buys conductors for these lines; Riyadh Cables already reports a supply contract with L&T.

projects.name: Expo 2030 Riyadh power supply
projects.scope: One bulk supply point and three primary substations, about 400 MW, plus grid connections. TDP awarded a 132 kV high-voltage cable package.
projects.parties: Al-Babtain Contracting, Haif, Alfanar, Trading & Development Partnership (TDP)
projects.relevance: Fixed-deadline giga-project; cable and conductor packages flow through the named contractors.

projects.name: Abqaiq and Rafaya 132/33 kV substations
projects.scope: Two substation contracts awarded in April 2026, including the 132/33 kV Rafaya substation; Abqaiq has moved into construction.
projects.relevance: Eastern Province grid reinforcement; associated 132 kV line work.

projects.name: Saudi NREP Round 7 (5.3 GW solar and wind)
projects.scope: Solar: Tabarjal 2 (1.4 GW), Mawqaq (600 MW), Tathleeth (600 MW), South AlUla (500 MW). Wind: Bilghah (1.3 GW), Shagran (900 MW). Bid deadline extended.
projects.relevance: Each plant needs grid connection lines and substations; renewables drive new transmission.

projects.name: Saudi–UAE grid interconnection MoU
projects.owner: Governments of Saudi Arabia and the UAE
projects.scope: MoU to set principles for power grid interconnection and electricity exchange, coordinated with possible expansion of the GCC grid; also covers rail.
projects.relevance: Early signal of a new cross-border line; watch for feasibility and tender.

projects.name: Rabigh 2 IPP expansion
projects.scope: EPC contract to expand the Rabigh 2 independent power plant.
projects.relevance: Competitor (Elsewedy) wins EPC scope in Saudi; plant evacuation lines may follow.

projects.name: Sitra 400/220 kV substations – cables and transformers
projects.scope: BD34.97m to Iljin Electric for 400 kV and 220 kV feeder cables to Sitra substations; BD15.94m to Hitachi Energy for transformers; BD13.24m for 66 kV transformers.
projects.relevance: Home market: a Korean cable maker won the largest cable package. Check how Midal can compete on the next EWA cable tenders.

projects.name: Jasra 400/220 kV grid substation
projects.scope: New 400/220 kV station (~2,000 MVA) and 9 new 66 kV substations; bids received for the 220 kV feeder cable works.
projects.relevance: Home market cable and conductor demand; feeder cable award still pending.

projects.name: Dukhan 2,000 MW solar – grid connection works
projects.scope: New 400/220/132 kV substation and upgrades to existing substations for the Dukhan solar plant. Bids were due 21 Aug 2026.
projects.relevance: 400 kV/132 kV lines for evacuation; Qatar targets 4,000 MW renewables by 2030.

projects.name: Nama–State Grid 1 GW battery storage (Duqm, Ibri)
projects.scope: Framework agreement for 1 GW of battery storage in Duqm and Ibri.
projects.relevance: Storage at Ibri sits next to the GCC interconnection; grid connections to follow.

projects.name: Clean Energy Link – East (Western Australia)
projects.scope: Transmission project; Acciona appointed to deliver a significant component.
projects.relevance: Export market: Australian transmission build-out.

projects.name: India ISTS 765 kV renewable-evacuation corridors (Rajasthan, Gujarat, Karnataka)
projects.scope: Dozens of 765 kV double-circuit lines under construction to evacuate renewable power from the Rajasthan, Khavda (Gujarat), Koppal, Bidar and Kurnool zones, e.g. Beawar–Dausa (240 km), Fatehgarh-3–Beawar, Bikaner-III–Neemrana-II, Halvad–Vataman. Most are due for commissioning during 2026.
projects.parties: POWERGRID, Adani Energy Solutions, Resonia (Sterlite Power), Tata Power
projects.relevance: The world's largest pipeline of 765 kV lines; very large conductor demand (AL59, ACSR, HTLS) served mainly by Indian makers such as APAR.

projects.name: Lakadia-II 765/400 kV ISTS scheme (Gujarat)
projects.scope: New 765/400 kV Lakadia-II substation and 765 kV lines to integrate 7.5 GW of renewables from the Lakadia zone.
projects.relevance: New 765 kV line packages; conductor tenders follow the award.

projects.name: Pune West 765 kV GIS substation and lines (Maharashtra)
projects.scope: 765 kV GIS substation at Pune West with 765 kV and 400 kV transmission lines and bays.
projects.relevance: Further 765/400 kV line volume in western India.

projects.name: Saudi–Iraq interconnection (Arar–Yusufiya)
projects.owner: Saudi Arabia / Iraq Ministry of Electricity
projects.scope: About 435 km transmission line from Arar in northern Saudi Arabia to Yusufiya near Baghdad, part of Iraq's push to import power from Saudi Arabia and Turkey.
projects.relevance: Long cross-border overhead line next to Midal's Saudi base.

projects.name: Iraq–GCC interconnection
projects.scope: Iraq's electricity link to the GCC grid is about 98% complete, according to Iraq's electricity ministry; Iraq is also raising imports from Turkey to 2,000 MW.
projects.relevance: Completion opens follow-on 400 kV reinforcement inside Iraq.

projects.name: Eskom / NTCSA transmission expansion and ITP programme
projects.owner: Eskom / NTCSA; Department of Electricity and Energy
projects.value: ~14,000 km of new lines over a decade
projects.scope: Plan to install about 14,000 km of transmission lines over the next decade (only 270.8 km installed in the year to March 2026); the expansion plan was delayed by six months. Independent Transmission Projects (ITP) programme launched to bring in private capital.
projects.relevance: Large 400/765 kV overhead-line market opening to private developers and imported conductors.

projects.name: Cameroon–Chad power interconnection
projects.scope: Cross-border interconnection that can no longer meet its 31 Dec 2027 completion target under current tender timelines for major contracts; completion now at least 2029.
projects.relevance: Development-bank-funded line still in procurement.

projects.name: Norwich to Tilbury 400 kV (Great Grid Upgrade)
projects.scope: About 183 km of new 400 kV transmission (about 159 km overhead line) through Norfolk, Suffolk and Essex. The planning examination is at the recommendation stage, due 10 Nov 2026.
projects.relevance: One of the largest new UK overhead lines; conductor procurement follows consent.

projects.name: North Coast Transmission Line (British Columbia)
projects.scope: Phase 1: 165 km, 500 kV line from Williston substation near Prince George to Glenannan; groundbreaking 3 Sep 2026, phased construction through 2030.
projects.relevance: Large 500 kV conductor requirement in North America.

projects.name: Churchill Falls expansion and Gull Island with transmission (Québec–Newfoundland and Labrador)
projects.scope: Agreement to expand Churchill Falls, build Gull Island and related transmission lines, for about 14,000 MW in total.
projects.parties: Governments of Canada, Québec, and Newfoundland and Labrador
projects.relevance: Multi-year HV transmission build in eastern Canada.

projects.name: AEP 765 kV lines for the Piketon, Ohio data-centre campus
projects.scope: Three planned 765 kV lines, each adding about 3.2 GW, to serve SB Energy's 10.4 GW data-centre campus; in service end-2028, 2029 and 2030. Jacobs and WSP engaged for AEP's transmission build-out.
projects.relevance: Data-centre-driven 765 kV build-out in the US: a large conductor market.

projects.name: DOE 'Speed to Power' accelerated reconductoring awards
projects.scope: Funding recipients are expected to reconductor or rebuild more than 1,500 miles of transmission lines and deploy grid-enhancing technologies.
projects.relevance: Direct demand for advanced and HTLS conductors (ACCC, ACSS), which Midal makes.

projects.name: Brazil Transmission Auction No. 4/2026
projects.scope: All eight lots awarded at an average 50.1% discount, including an integration with Bolivia and more capacity in Mato Grosso do Sul.
projects.parties: Neoenergia, EDP, CYMI, Celeo Redes, Cox Brasil
projects.relevance: Winners now procure conductors and towers; Brazil runs several auctions a year.

projects.name: Brazil 2027 transmission auction (3,245 km)
projects.scope: Proposed auction of 3,245 km of new transmission lines, including the first battery storage contracted in a transmission auction.
projects.relevance: Next large conductor opportunity in Latin America.

projects.name: Odensala–Kappetorp 400 kV line
projects.scope: New 400 kV line; Dalekovod's bid selected, with work planned from 2026 to early 2030.
projects.relevance: Large Nordic 400 kV line; conductor supply flows through the EPC contractor.

projects.name: Skogssäter–Kilanda 400 kV line
projects.scope: 43 km 400 kV power line.
projects.relevance: Part of Sweden's west-coast grid reinforcement; another Dalekovod package.

projects.name: Oradea Sud–Nadab 400 kV line section
projects.scope: Construction of the Oradea Sud–Nadab section of a 400 kV line in western Romania.
projects.relevance: Eastern European 400 kV build-out, part of Romania's ring closure; EU-funded lines open to imported conductors.

projects.name: Bajina Bašta–Obrenovac 400 kV corridor
projects.scope: New double-circuit 400 kV line between Bajina Bašta and Obrenovac; EMS signed the substation contract on 24 April 2026 (EUR 36 million for substations).
projects.relevance: Western Balkans 400 kV line package still to come; development-bank-funded tenders.

projects.name: Endrup–Idomlund and Endrup–German border 400 kV OHL towers
projects.scope: Tower supply for new 400 kV overhead lines in western Jutland (linked to the Thor offshore wind grid connection).
projects.relevance: New 400 kV overhead lines in Denmark; the conductor packages are separate procurements to watch.

projects.name: Sudbury–Barrie 500 kV line (Hanmer–Essa)
projects.scope: Single-circuit 500 kV line from Hanmer to Essa; Ontario directed the OEB on 9 Feb 2026 to have Hydro One build it, in service by 2032; community open houses held in April 2026.
projects.relevance: New 500 kV line in Ontario: a multi-year conductor requirement.

projects.name: Greenstone 230 kV transmission line
projects.scope: OEB decision of 29 Jan 2026 amended Hydro One's licence to require it to pursue the line, following IESO recommendations.
projects.relevance: Northern Ontario 230 kV build.

projects.name: Durham Kawartha Power Line
projects.scope: Leave-to-construct application to the Ontario Energy Board (June 2026); First Nations partners may take up to 50% equity in the transmission part.
projects.relevance: Central/eastern Ontario line awaiting approval.

projects.name: Welland–Thorold (Niagara) transmission reinforcement
projects.scope: About 18.5 km of new transmission lines; approved by the Ontario Energy Board on 9 July 2026, cost estimate found reasonable.
projects.relevance: Approved and moving towards construction; conductor procurement next.

projects.name: Orléans Area Reinforcement (east Ottawa)
projects.scope: About 11 km of 115 kV line in an existing corridor, plus conversion of an existing line to 230 kV.
projects.relevance: Urban reinforcement; reconductoring/upgrade demand.
